theme: Light theme by default with crisp contrast, clean borders, professional indigo/blue accents, and rich dark charcoal details

entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth — trust positioning panel & value prop left, secure clean login form right
entry_surfaces./register: branded split auth — value prop & quick setup promise left, registration form right
entry_surfaces./recuperar-senha: centered branded card with return to login flow

layouts_and_grids.desktop_shell: Sidebar 260px fixed width + Topbar with user profile and quick search + Main scrollable content area max-w-7xl px-8 py-8
layouts_and_grids.mobile_shell: Sticky compact top header with ClientePro logo & notification bell + Fixed bottom navigation bar (5 primary items) + Content area px-4 py-6 pb-24 for seamless iPhone/Android thumb reach
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: Grid 1 cols on mobile, 2 cols on tablet (md), 3 cols on desktop (lg:grid-cols-3) for the 6 primary KPI cards (Clientes Ativos, Vencendo Hoje, Vencendo em Breve, Vencidos, Faturamento do Mês, Pagamentos Pendentes)
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_sections: 2-column layout on desktop: Left column (col-span-2) with 'Próximos Vencimentos' + 'Tabela de Clientes Atrasados' with one-click Cobrança WhatsApp; Right column (col-span-1) with 'Ações Rápidas' & 'Resumo Financeiro Rápido'
layouts_and_grids.clients_crud_layout: Header with 'Novo Cliente' CTA + Search bar with filter chips (Todos, Ativos, Vencendo, Em Atraso, Inativos) + Mobile responsive card/table view with direct WhatsApp & status actions + Add/Edit Sheet Dialog

motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-in-up (opacity: 0, y: 12 -> opacity: 1, y: 0) with 0.25s duration
motion_and_interactions.buttons: hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform duration-150 ease-out shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
motion_and_interactions.mobile_drawer: Smooth slide-in sheet from bottom/left with spring physics
motion_and_interactions.toasts: Sonner with richColors for quick confirmation of CRUD operations, WhatsApp link copy, and payment registrations

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px on all interactive mobile buttons and navigation items
accessibility.contrast_check: Every text token complies with WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive buttons, inputs, filter tabs, modal triggers, and KPI metric containers MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes
accessibility.screen_readers: Descriptive aria-labels on icon-only actions (e.g., WhatsApp button, delete client, edit client, close modal)

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend + React 19 / Vite frontend). Tailwind v4 is in frontend/src/index.css.

Do not build a simple landing page only. Build a completely functional, solid SaaS app with full client CRUD, interactive Dashboard, authentication with persistent state, onboarding wizard, and responsive mobile-first shell.
Implement Portuguese (pt-BR) as the primary interface language throughout the app and landing page.

For the Landing Page, use the specified title: 'Pare de perder clientes por esquecer vencimentos.' with clear call-to-actions, feature highlights, and pricing plans (ex: Plano Mensal R$ 49/mês e Plano Anual R$ 39/mês).
Onboarding must capture: 1. Nome do negócio, 2. Nome do responsável, 3. Segmento, 4. Telefone.

Shell navigation MUST contain all 8 sections: Dashboard, Clientes, Pagamentos, Financeiro, Calendário, Lembretes, Relatórios, Configurações. Clientes is full CRUD with real persistence; other secondary sections should have rich interactive features/views rather than empty screens.
Include Quick Actions in the Dashboard: 'Adicionar cliente', 'Registrar pagamento', and 'Enviar cobrança' (generating customizable WhatsApp pre-filled text with client name and amount).
Mobile Responsiveness: Test on mobile viewport (375px-430px) ensuring touch targets are 44px+ and bottom nav is comfortable.
Ensure all interactive items have data-testid attributes for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only for sticky headers, never transparent dropdowns.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Keep natural left-aligned reading rhythm for dashboards and forms.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or subtle rounded-xl with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use clean Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, active press states, smooth tab transitions, and entrance staggered effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
